mechanism.claim: At a completed common funding settlement, same-sign funding-level residuals across at least four of six liquid alt perpetuals and BTC identify market-wide leveraged crowding rather than an idiosyncratic contract imbalance. When the cross-alt residual magnitude and BTC variation are elevated, fade the common crowding direction for one funding cycle.
mechanism.side: negative strict common sign of the alt majority and BTC funding residual
mechanism.why_distinct: CAFACR used settlement-to-settlement funding acceleration and required the alt majority to contradict BTC. HVEFR used only one BTC funding-level residual. CAFLCR uses contemporaneous level-residual breadth confirmed by BTC at an exact common settlement; it is neither a threshold, side, clock, hold, subset, source substitution, nor diagnostic-control repair of either terminal candidate.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: cross-alt funding residual magnitude and completed prior-24h BTC variation must both be causal upper-tail states; RV20 q90 remains only a post-stage audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: only broad common-settlement residual concordance events are eligible

features.settlement: an exact funding_time shared by all seven funding_rates_binance symbols with one finite funding_rate and positive finite mark_price per symbol
features.funding_residual: current rate minus the symbol's median over at most 90 strictly prior valid settlements, minimum 60, current excluded; strict zero is ineligible for breadth
features.alt_breadth: at least four of six alt residuals share one strict sign
features.btc_confirmation: BTC residual has the same strict sign as the alt majority
features.crowding_magnitude: median absolute residual across the six alts
features.crowding_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 prior common valid settlements, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTCUSDT one-minute log(close/open)) over exact 24 elapsed hours ending at funding_time
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 prior common valid settlements, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact common funding_time after all seven settlement rows and prior BTC path exist
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_accounting: signal settlement is causally complete and excluded from held funding cash; exact settlements with entry<=time<exit are applied only after novelty
clock.oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; RV20 q90 only after all economic stages pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent broad funding-level crowding mechanism plus volatile-market focus

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no residual, breadth, confirmation, rank, variation, side, hold, clock, universe, subset, or control repair
